objective: measure useful capability overlap between HERUS and local language-model baselines without claiming unrestricted equivalence
central_question: Which language, reasoning, groundedness, continuity and safety capabilities can HERUS match, exceed or fail against a reproducible local LLM baseline?
non_claims: not a benchmark of speech recognition or human perception
not factuality in the open world unless evidence is frozen and auditable
not a product claim based on one aggregate score

task_families.question: Can varied but bounded Portuguese inputs map to the same canonical typed meaning?
task_families.input: controlled Portuguese utterances with paraphrase and syntax splits
task_families.target: canonical typed IR or explicit abstention

task_families.question: Can the system distinguish entailment, contradiction and unknown in natural Brazilian Portuguese?
task_families.target: entailment, contradiction or unknown label with optional abstention

task_families.question: Can known primitives be recombined in unseen legal structures?
task_families.input: typed facts, rules and held-out compositions
task_families.target: answer kind, canonical proof and provenance roots

task_families.question: Can the system answer from an authorized personal evidence set without inventing unsupported claims?
task_families.input: frozen evidence cards with current, expired, revoked and conflicting variants
task_families.target: answer text plus evidence IDs, provenance and abstention reason

task_families.question: Can the system produce useful novel language while preserving a supplied meaning?
task_families.input: canonical meanings and bounded user-facing tasks
task_families.target: response text, preserved meaning and provenance class

task_families.question: Can the system preserve useful state across turns, interruption, confirmation and reboot?
task_families.input: frozen dialogue traces with allowed and forbidden transitions
task_families.target: next response class, state transition and scrub result

task_families.question: Does the system answer when supported and abstain when evidence or authority is insufficient?
task_families.input: mixed answerable, unanswerable, ambiguous, conflicting and adversarial cases
task_families.target: answer, qualify, clarify, abstain or block

task_families.question: What useful capability is obtained per bounded local resource cost?
task_families.input: same task corpus and fixed runtime configuration
task_families.target: quality, memory, flash, latency, energy and network trace

risk_coverage_definition.accepted_prediction: a non-abstained prediction whose confidence threshold is met
risk_coverage_definition.risk: weighted error among accepted predictions, with silent failures counted explicitly

human_evaluation.blinding: system identity hidden and outputs randomized
human_evaluation.inter_rater_agreement: report the selected agreement statistic and missing ratings

release_gates.open_language_claim: forbidden until a frozen natural-language task set is measured
release_gates.full_llm_equivalence_claim: forbidden until every mandatory dimension has comparable evidence

mandatory_comparison_conditions: same frozen cases for HERUS and local baseline where the task interface is semantically compatible
separate results for in-distribution, compositional OOD, natural-language OOD and adversarial cases
report abstentions as outcomes rather than deleting them from the denominator
report unsupported or ungrounded claims separately from ordinary task errors
report zero-authority and privacy properties separately from language quality
publish scoring code, corpus digest and environment metadata before interpreting results

decision_rule.capability_parity: may be claimed only per task family when confidence intervals or exact finite-case evidence overlap the preregistered threshold
decision_rule.system_level_parity: cannot be claimed from a weighted average; requires all mandatory dimensions and no release-gate violation
decision_rule.interim_claim: HERUS is comparable on explicitly measured local typed capabilities while open-language LLM parity remains unknown

research_sources.use: versioned tasks, local model backends and reproducible prompts
